description: Single-card summon cycle: shared card/button action, 600ms reverse flip before the next existing summon transaction, cancellation on tavern close, repeated-tap guard, keyboard access and reduced-motion fallback. Existing RNG, costs, first free summon and hero grant code remain unchanged.

edits.name: wrap existing summon transaction with cancellable reverse flip
cancel pending reverse without purchasing when tavern closes
remove reveal-only card handler to prevent duplicate bubbling
route idle and revealed card taps and keyboard through shared summon action
make starting card keyboard accessible
